description: This file defines the ComprehendMedicalClient class within the Aws\ComprehendMedical namespace. It extends the AwsClient to provide an interface for interacting with the AWS Comprehend Medical service, including methods for discovering medical entities, jobs management, and inference operations. The class contains PHPDoc annotations describing available methods for synchronous and asynchronous API calls.
